fields.quote: Status page and monitoring, free forever. Paid plans are a flat price, never per seat.

notes: The snapshot did not capture the Pro and Business amounts: the pricing page shows only '/ month' next to these plans (prices are probably rendered client-side), so their amounts must be null/unknown and any dollar figure reported for them is unsupported. Starter is free ('Free' on the pricing page, '$0/month' and 'Free forever plan' on the home page). A yearly toggle ('Yearly 25% off'; FAQ: 'three months free') exists but no yearly amount is displayed. Enterprise has no price ('Contact us Book a demo'). The savings calculator mentions Pingdom, PagerDuty and Atlassian Statuspage as replaced tools, not as plans. The customers page lists logos and quotes (Vercel, Siemens, KFC, etc.): company-stated, not payment proof. 'Instatus, Inc' gives no country, so country_code is forbidden. The non-profit/open-source free Pro account is a discount, not a plan. 'It really felt like a partnership' (customer quote) is incidental; the product is status pages and monitoring, eligible.
